plain_english: In the body of skin, blood, flesh, fat, marrow, bone — ever sick: Māyā, you plunge the knowing and the unknowing, unknowing of your greatness.
sanskrit_cite: tvagrudhiramāṃsamedomajjāsthimaye sadāmaye kāye | māye majjayasi tvaṃ māhātmyaṃ te janānajānānān

plain_english: Gods set up in metal-drawn images — seeing them, 'hā hā alas' say the unfulfilled. For body-dwellers proud with body-I-ness — what delusion does Māyā not birth?
sanskrit_cite: lohālekhyasthāpitān vīkṣya devān | hā hā hantetyāhureke'kṛtārthāḥ | dehāhantāśālināṃ dehabhājāṃ | mohāveśaṃ kaṃ na māyā prasūte

plain_english: From all that is born of delusion-play-arisen voided-intellect, body-and-all I-ness — protect me from falling, supreme goddess, whose form is self-awareness born of effort.
Terrible-natured, most terrible, non-terrible; called higher and lower, neither lower nor higher. Seeing Śiva's manifold power, I abide in wonder.
sanskrit_cite: ghorātmikāṃ ghoratamāmaghorāṃ parāparākhyāmaparāṃ parāṃ ca | vicitrarūpāṃ śivayorvibhūtiṃ vilokayan vismayamāna āste

plain_english: Dwelling in the midst of the rays of the higher and the lower — no insistence of mine on judgments of being, nonbeing, being-nonbeing.
Your unsurpassed form flashes, and the other world-made one, O mother. Remembering both — to the good, fear-giving, boon-giving, supreme goddess.
sanskrit_cite: sphurati yattava rūpamanuttaraṃ yadaparaṃ ca jaganmayamambike | ubhayametadanusmaratāṃ satāmabhayade varade paradevate

plain_english: Lady of the five acts, supreme-knowing-formed Pārvatī, be gracious. Lift the fallen beast-fettered one; soothe the child with cool glances.
sanskrit_cite: parameśvari pañcakṛtyalīle parasaṃvinmayi pārvati prasīda | patitaṃ paśupāśamuddharemaṃ śiśumāśvāsaya śītalaiḥ kaṭākṣeḥ

plain_english: Having bowed to perfected gurus, gods, goddess, then yogins — by Abhinavagupta these fifteen verses were uttered.
sanskrit_cite: pūrvasiddhān gurūn devān devīṃ natvātha yoginaḥ | ime'bhinavaguptena ślokāḥ pañcadaśeritāḥ
